metas.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
metas.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

metas.name: Super Sharanya
metas.description: Sharanya, an ordinary small-town girl from Palakkad, who moves to Thrissur for higher studies, finds herself changing as she meets Deepu.

metas.name: Mollywood Times
metas.description: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

metas.name: Premalu
metas.description: Sachin, a carefree graduate, crosses paths with Reenu, a spirited IT professional, in Hyderabad. As their friendship deepens, unspoken feelings, career ambitions and life choices challenge their bond.

metas.name: Hello Dear
metas.description: A hello is just the beginning. The magic lies in everything that follows

metas.name: Secret of Kalinga
metas.description: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

metas.name: Athiradi
metas.description: Energetic student Samkutty revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

metas.name: Bharathanatyam 2 Mohiniyattam
metas.description: The family's journey to Sreekandapuram to settle the late Bharathan Nair's second wife and son takes a dark turn when an issue from his past resurfaces, leading to an unexpected crime. Forced into a desperate cover-up to protect their future, the family must navigate a treacherous path of secrecy and mounting pressure, determined to overcome any obstacle by any means necessary.

metas.name: Sarvam Maya
metas.description: An atheist priest's life is upended after performing an exorcism, bonding with a charming spirit who helps him pursue music and heal his past.

metas.name: Minnal Murali
metas.description: A tailor gains special powers after being struck by lightning but must take down an unexpected foe if he is to become the superhero his hometown in Kerala needs.

metas.name: Sumathi Valavu
metas.description: A haunted curve in 1990s Kerala, named after Sumathis tragic death, draws various people into supernatural encounters. As they experience strange events, the mystery of Sumathi and the roads dark history begins to unfold.

metas.name: Kurukkante Kalyanam
metas.description: Sivasubrahmania, a 32-year-old unhappy bachelor, shifts to another city in order to escape from his religious father. Desperate for affection, he falls in love with a girl 14 years younger than him.

metas.name: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu
metas.description: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.

metas.name: Pandippada
metas.description: Bhuvana wishes to sell his land to clear his debts. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he finds himself caught in the power battle between two landlords.

metas.name: Premam
metas.description: Three stages in George's life, and three girls he encounters in each stage.

metas.name: Vaazha II
metas.description: Four friends – Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak – are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family and the school management. They face immense social pressure as they reach adulthood, embarking them on an emotional journey of self discovery and acceptance, where they finally learn to take up their responsibilities and find success.

metas.name: Madhuvidhu
metas.description: When Amrutharaj, a groom from an all-male household repeatedly rejected by brides' families, falls in love with Sneha Marcose, their journey toward marriage ignites a chain of hilarious chaos inside his unruly home.

metas.name: Manichitrathazhu
metas.description: A young couple, Ganga and Nakulan, arrives at the ancestral home called Madampalli of the latter. Hailing from a family that follows tradition and superstitions, Nakulan's uncle Thampi objects to the couple's idea of moving into the allegedly haunted mansion, which Nakulan ignores. The couple moves in anyway following which seemingly supernatural events begin to happen.

metas.name: Drama
metas.description: Set in UK, Drama follows the hilarious yet enthralling journey of a funeral director, who sets out to fulfill the final wish of one of his clients.

metas.name: Aavesham
metas.description: Three college freshmen in Bangalore befriend an eccentric gangster to get revenge on their senior bullies.

metas.name: Oru Small Family
metas.description: Viswanathan takes to drinking when his daughter falls in love with Kishore, who comes from a family selling illicit liquor. Tired of Viswanathan's alcoholism, his wife decides to set things right.

metas.name: Four
metas.description: It is about a wronged teacher, who returns to the government school from where he lost his job to guide the students along the right path.

metas.name: Godha
metas.description: A washed-up wrestler's life changes when he brings a passionate female wrestler from Punjab to his conservative Kerala village, sparking a comedic yet inspiring revolution in the local wrestling pits.

metas.name: Bhishmar
metas.description: Two men meet by chance, setting off a night of chaos with romance and action, as their paths cross and intertwine through various unexpected events.

metas.name: Spa
metas.description: The narrative follows the intertwined lives of people connected to La Paradise, an urban massage therapy centre. It centres on Mathan, a man struggling to distinguish between the reality of love and its fictionalised ideals. Through a sharp lens of social satire, the story explores adult themes and human behaviour within this unique urban setting.

metas.name: Derby
metas.description: A campus entertainer who follows a group of college students navigating friendship, rivalry, love, and ambition. What begins as carefree fun soon turns into intense competition as campus pride and personal egos come into play.

metas.name: Prakambanam
metas.description: A group of students' lives are thrown into chaos after one of them is possessed by the spirit of an elderly woman.

metas.name: Ekadesham
metas.description: In Kochi, the lives, work, and relationships of a bunch of young people overlap as they try to navigate their role in the film world.

metas.name: Cameo
metas.description: Armed with high hopes and small wallets, three youngsters set out to make their dream film. But when an actor with a flair for drama joins the team, their journey quickly spirals into mayhem.

metas.name: Aadu 3 Part 1
metas.description: Shaji Pappan and Co. opens a Pandora's box of reincarnations and multiple timelines  leading to comic chaos of epic proportions.

metas.name: Pranaya Vilasam
metas.description: A revelation about a woman's old flame sends shockwaves through her family. Portrays love stories of different characters who are at different stages of their lives.

metas.name: Karakkam
metas.description: A drunken New Year's prank goes horribly wrong when two young men remove sacred crosses from graves. Five restless ghosts emerge to haunt their every move, driving them to seek redemption and release.

metas.name: Thaskara Lahala
metas.description: In order to help a girl get married, three close friends stage a play to collect money. However, in an unexpected twist of fate, a thief steals the profits from the play.

metas.name: Romancham
metas.description: Set in 2007, in the outskirts of Bengaluru, A game of Ouija board goes hilariously wrong when seven bachelors unexpectedly invite a spirit and try to make the best out of the situation.

metas.name: Ivan Maryadaraman
metas.description: Raman meets Krishnendu, the daughter of his father's enemy, on the way to his hometown. Once he reaches his hometown, he finds himself hunted by his rivals.
